rejected.title: Semi-Charmed Life
rejected.rejectedReason: Rejected on lane, not availability -- it passed every mechanical check (right recording, embeddable, wide licence, artist not already on the station). DISTORTION FIELD is grunge/alt-rock proper: guitars, raw vocals, radio-ready angst, the early-to-mid-90s Seattle sound and its ripple effects, explicitly not pop-rock crossover. Semi-Charmed Life (1997, San Francisco) sits at the bright, jangly, radio-pop end of the decade -- dark lyric notwithstanding -- and next to Nirvana, Alice In Chains and Screaming Trees it would read as the odd one out. Proposed in issue #27 on the argument "it is 90s rock, it is good", which is a case for the decade rather than for this station; a counter-argument that the lane is drawn too tight was explicitly invited on 2026-08-27 and not made. This is the track that would test that boundary if anyone wants to argue it.
